== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Electrobinoculars (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Electrobinoculars]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-electrobinoculars/ SWCCG Cards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_Electrobinoculars.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c9d069689af3de3013d65eb80767529dd573b82031cf37948d4763859d59e1b6</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
